provenance.summary: Seeded from verified monitor totals for Nov 1–6, 2026 and from run-level journals whose daily sums match those totals. No X API call was made from this repository. Per-account profile rankings are omitted until a verified account export is ingested.
sources: Verified daily monitor totals: Nov 1 = 41 (40 AM + 1 PM, excluding 7 preexisting), Nov 2 = 17, Nov 3 = 13, Nov 4 = 1, Nov 5 = 378 (11 + 179 + 188), total 450 through Nov 5
Nov 6 partial: 110 verified at 11:35 AM ET from an approved 347 batch, 237 remaining, later routine interrupted
Run journals for clock times, list size, and already-blocked counts where they add up to those daily totals. The Nov 1 PM block is the 9:00 PM ET run
Point-in-time snapshots: Nov 5 11:35 PM ET (X blocks 453, list 561, 127 unblocked on the list), Nov 6 9:00 AM ET (list 775, 428 blocked, 347 unblocked, X blocks 452), Nov 6 11:35 AM ET (X blocks 562)
